svg.title: Prefix sum plus hash map sweep for k = 4
svg.desc: running totals 3, 2, 6, 7, 2, 11, 13; need = running - 4; matches at i = 2, 3 and 5 give total 3. The running total 2 repeats at i = 4, so seen[2] becomes 2. Final seen: 0:1, 3:1, 2:2, 6:1, 7:1, 11:1, 13:1.
svg.text: found = seen[need], read before running is inserted
